question: What is the difference between RPO (Recovery Point Objective) and RTO (Recovery Time Objective)?
category: What is the difference between RPO (Recovery Point Objective) and RTO (Recovery Time Objective)?

options.text: RPO: maximum acceptable data loss measured in time; RTO: maximum acceptable downtime until service restoration.
Restoring a base physical backup and replaying continuous Write-Ahead Logs (WAL/binlog) up to an exact specific microsecond timestamp.
Expand: add new column/table while maintaining old; Contract: migrate application traffic to new structure, then drop old structure online.
To abort immediately if an exclusive lock cannot be acquired within milliseconds, preventing blocking application traffic queues.

explanation: RPO: maximum acceptable data loss measured in time; RTO: maximum acceptable downtime until service restoration.
